content.rendered:
Selected Homme Structured Polo T-Shirt with Logo – Premium Organic Cotton

Elevate your everyday wardrobe with the Selected Homme Structured Polo T-Shirt with Logo, a perfect blend of modern tailoring, sustainability, and comfort. Designed for men who value premium craftsmanship and eco-conscious fashion, this polo t-shirt delivers a refined look suitable for casual wear, smart-casual outfits, and all-day comfort.

Crafted using a superior composition of 98% organic cotton and 2% elastane, this polo offers natural breathability with just the right amount of stretch. The use of recycled organic cotton fabric ensures durability while significantly reducing environmental impact, making it a responsible choice for conscious consumers.

Premium Fabric & Construction

With a 200 GSM fabric weight, the strikes the ideal balance between structure and lightness. The fabric undergoes advanced singeing and sanforising processes, resulting in a smoother surface, reduced pilling, and long-lasting shape retention even after multiple washes.

The dry fit and lightweight construction enhances moisture management, keeping you cool and fresh throughout the day. Whether you are heading to work, traveling, or enjoying a relaxed weekend outing, this structured adapts effortlessly to your lifestyle.

Texture Finish with Eco-Friendly Traits

Featuring a refined texture finish, this delivers a premium hand feel and an elegant appearance. Manufactured in a green facility, the production process follows eco-friendly standards, reducing water usage and carbon footprint without compromising on quality or style. The embroidered logo adds a subtle yet distinctive brand identity, enhancing the overall sophistication of the design while maintaining versatility for everyday wear.

Available Colors

  • Primrose Yellow – Fresh, vibrant, and perfect for summer styling
  • Black – Timeless, versatile, and effortlessly stylish
  • White – Clean, classic, and ideal for minimal looks

Why Choose?

  • Premium Selected Homme structured polo t-shirt with logo
  • Eco-conscious 98% organic cotton, 2% elastane composition
  • Durable recycled organic cotton fabric
  • Comfortable 200 GSM lightweight dry fit
  • Enhanced softness with singeing and sanforising
  • Stylish texture finish for a premium look
  • Manufactured as a green facility product
  • Available in Primrose Yellow, Black, and White

Style & Versatility

Pair the with chinos, denim jeans, or tailored trousers for a polished yet relaxed appearance. Its structured silhouette ensures a flattering fit, while the stretchable fabric allows freedom of movement, making it ideal for both casual and semi-formal occasions. Whether layered under a jacket or worn on its own, this remains a wardrobe essential for men seeking sustainable fashion with a premium edge.

Care Instructions

  • Machine wash cold
  • Do not bleach
  • Tumble dry low or line dry
  • Warm iron if required

Upgrade your collection with the where comfort, sustainability, and modern design come together for effortless everyday style.
